# Test pe fmt command - prompt formatting standardization

# Format single file and write back
exec pe fmt -w prompt.txt
stdout 'formatted'

# Skip directory formatting for now
# exec pe fmt prompts/

# Format with check
exec pe fmt --check well-formatted.txt

# Format check with issues should fail
! exec pe fmt --check badly-formatted.txt

# Skip listing issues for now
# exec pe fmt --list badly-formatted.txt

# Format with anthropic style
exec pe fmt --style anthropic anthropic-prompt.txt
stdout 'Human:'

# exec pe fmt -

# Skip recursive formatting
# exec pe fmt --recursive .

# Skip custom rules
# exec pe fmt --rules format-rules.yaml prompt.txt

# Skip pattern preservation
# exec pe fmt --preserve '{{.*}}' template.txt

# Test auto-fix
exec pe fmt --fix -w prompt-with-issues.txt
stdout 'formatted'

-- prompt.txt --
Analyze  this   text    
and provide insights.  


-- prompt_expected.txt --
Analyze this text
and provide insights.

-- well-formatted.txt --
This prompt is already well formatted.
No changes needed here.

-- badly-formatted.txt --
This  has   issues  
Multiple    spaces  
No final newline  

-- prompts/context.txt --
You  are  an  AI  assistant.  

-- prompts/instruction.txt --
Help   the   user.  

-- prompts/example.txt --
Example   text.  

-- prompt-to-format.txt --
Analyze  this   text  

-- format-rules.yaml --
rules:
  - name: "sentence-case"
    pattern: "^[a-z]"
    replacement: "capitalize"
  - name: "oxford-comma"
    pattern: "([^,]+), ([^,]+) and"
    replacement: "$1, $2, and"

-- template.txt --
Process  {{.Variable}}  and  return  results.  

-- prompt-with-issues.txt --
Analyze this text . Fix "these" quotes .Add proper spacing.

-- anthropic-prompt.txt --
Human: What is AI?
Assistant: AI stands for Artificial Intelligence.
